text: 创业板指半日涨近1%，算力硬件股集体反弹。 恒指半日跌0.8%，恒生科技指数跌1.4%，美团、比亚迪股份等跌超3%。 美联储Paulson：目前逐步收紧政策似乎是合适的。 美联储古尔斯比：我们面临真正的通胀问题，必须加以应对。 美国众议院投票阻止针对赫格塞斯的弹劾条款。 OpenAI第三季度营收增至100亿美元，但持续面临巨额亏损。 刘强东也要入局短剧？京东内测独立短剧产品。
text_en: ChiNext Index rose nearly 1% in the morning session, with computing power hardware stocks rebounding across the board. Hang Seng Index fell 0.8% in the morning session, Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.4%, with Meituan and BYD shares down more than 3%. Fed's Paulson: gradual policy tightening seems appropriate for now. Fed's Goolsbee: we have a real inflation problem and must address it. US House votes to block impeachment articles against Hegseth. OpenAI Q3 revenue rose to $10 billion but continues to face huge losses. Richard Liu also entering short dramas? JD.com tests a standalone short-drama product.
